$comment: Machine-readable e2e scenario manifest for AI agents. Each scenario maps to a spec file; agents may also execute steps manually with a browser tool and must capture the listed screenshots into output/screenshots/<project>/. Viewport projects: desktop-1280, tablet-768, mobile-360, iphone-safari (real WebKit engine, iPhone UA + touch).

scenarios.description: WCAG 2.1 AA axe checks of public, buyer, seller and admin routes in light and dark at all three viewport widths. JSON attachments retain violations and manual-review findings; a11y-role-index screenshots capture every scanned route.

steps.action: scan workspace routes in light and dark
steps.expect: HTTP 200, visible main content and no automated WCAG A/AA violations

scenarios.description: Public pages and the registration/login boundary.

steps.expect: page renders with a title
email and password inputs visible
name and email inputs visible
lands on /account or /email/verify
stays on /login with validation feedback

scenarios.description: Focus indicator pattern: one 1px ring on the header search field and the quantity stepper in the app, plus every control on the styleguide foundation page, in light and dark.

steps.expect: search input shows a single 1px outline, offset 0 (hugs the border)

steps.url: product page -> Add to cart -> stepper
steps.expect: ring on the stepper container, none on the inner input
each control shows exactly one 2px indicator in light and dark

scenarios.description: Full order lifecycle across the three roles: buyer checkout, seller fulfilment, admin moderation. Tests run serially and share one database; the buyer test seeds cart/address/report through the app's own endpoints.

steps.note: seeded buyer; must be email-verified (seeders set email_verified_at)

steps.expect: buyer has a default address, a selected cart item, and a pending report
order is placed (COD, default shipping) and listed under /account/orders
order shows under To Ship; Arrange shipment moves it to To Receive
same order reference and total, tracking visible, receipt completes the order, review submits
buyer's report appears in the moderation queue and can be approved

scenarios.description: Regression: admin routes render only the admin shell (no storefront chrome); pages that render their own shell are not double-wrapped.

steps.expect: main[data-shell=admin] visible, zero [data-shell=public]
main[data-shell=admin] visible, zero [data-shell=public]
main[data-shell=admin] visible, zero [data-shell=public]
redirected to /admin/dashboard (buyer surfaces stripped for admins)
redirected to /admin/dashboard (seller surfaces stripped for admins)
exactly one [data-shell] element (app)
exactly one [data-shell] element (app)

scenarios.description: Storefront chrome: product-card states (regular, discounted, frozen/halal, sold out, long name) snapshotted at 360/768/1280 in light and dark; category-nav states (default/hover/active/focus, no current item on home); WCAG contrast on price, old price, promo tag and nav text in both themes; footer trust strip, link groups, legal bar and sub-640px disclosures.

steps.expect: price is the strongest text; promo only on the -NN% tag; halal badge gated by category; sold-out card dimmed with tag
aria-current on the current category, 2px indicator, hover pill brand-50/700, 1px offset-2 focus ring; none active on /
contrast >= 4.5:1 for price, old price, tag, nav text in light and dark
trust strip, 5 link groups + brand block, legal bar; disclosures below 640px with aria-expanded

scenarios.description: Seller application lifecycle: error summary on empty submit, PSGC cascading selects with auto-filled postal code, file uploads (logo PNG, permit/cert PDFs), certificate add/remove, client-side checklist completion, submit into pending state, admin approval via the moderation queue (type=shop_application), and the applicant entering the seller workspace. Once approved, /seller/register 404s for the applicant.

steps.note: seeded verified buyer with no shop

steps.expect: danger Banner summary visible and focused, error links jump to fields

steps.note: PSGC selects region→province→city→barangay, postal auto-filled+locked from city, uploads via input[type=file]
steps.expect: checklist items turn done
pending Banner 'Application under review'
application item shows shop name and documents; Approve decides it and returns to the queue
approved applicant reaches the seller workspace instead of bouncing to /seller/register
public terms page: h1, version line, draft warning banner, TOC anchors

scenarios.description: Seller Finance page (W3-23): balance cards, ledger entries, payout account setup, payout request, and admin marks the request as paid.

steps.expect: balance-available, balance-pending, balance-paid data-test elements visible; at least one ledger-row present from the order-lifecycle spec
GCash method hint visible after redirect
payout-row with status 'requested' appears in history
payout-request row visible; Mark paid button present

steps.action: fill transfer reference and click Mark paid
steps.expect: row flips to 'paid' badge
payout-row shows 'paid'

scenarios.description: Admin console (W3-30–W3-34): user search, suspend/lift, category CRUD with commission, voucher CRUD, and audit log.

steps.expect: user-row elements visible; search filter works
